name: Remote MCP Server Authless
description: A template for deploying remote Model Context Protocol servers to Cloudflare Workers using Server-Sent Events without authentication. It allows developers to quickly host custom tools and connect them to clients like Claude Desktop or the Cloudflare AI Playground.
